{{CorrectTitle|title=Imperial Bounty #82,471|reason=#}}
{{Quote|Adar Tallon, in accordance with Imperial Bounty #82,471, I demand your surrender.|IG-72|<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Bounty #82,471''' was the designation number of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] that was posted for the head of [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The bounty was issued by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ranif Parlan]], and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who were [[Escape from Tatooine|attempting]] to collect on it included [[Jodo Kast]], [[Zardra]], [[Puggles Trodd/Legends|Puggles Trodd]] and [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]]. However, Tallon managed to escape all of them, eventually joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Captain Parlan was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] because of his failure to ensure Tallon's capture.<ref name="TM" />
